Members of Bayan, the Moro-Christian Peoples Alliance, and the Philippine-Palestine Friendship Association stage an indignation protest at the corner of E. Rodriguez Avenue and Gilmore Street in Quezon City on Saturday, August 9, 2025, to condemn Israel’s planned ground invasion of Gaza.

Protesters denounce the move as part of Israel’s ongoing genocidal campaign, citing the rising civilian death toll and humanitarian crisis in the besieged Palestinian territory. | via Maria Tan, ABS-CBN News
